canonical.relationship: The fresh Canonical readback contains a DNS outage entry published at 14:26 UTC, consistent with the Ubuntu mirror resolution errors subsequently recorded in the repository jobs. Each local APT failure is established independently by its retained log.

runner_issue.title: ubuntu-26.04: apt can't resolve archive.ubuntu.com / security.ubuntu.com since ~13:48 UTC 11 Nov
runner_issue.scope: Separate public runner report, not an official incident diagnosis. The reporter describes repeated Ubuntu mirror resolution failures on Ubuntu 26.04 while GitHub/npm downloads still worked.

ubuntu26_inventory.scope: Official fixed inventory linked from the actual audit, AVX2 candidate, portable x86 CT, and Tamarin job logs. These logs show ubuntu-26.04 image 20261101.186.1.
